one_line: A tool shown in hand and in mouth from the first second, with one comment word for the link.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a low-angle selfie, a clear mouthpiece in one hand, at 0:01 a white box in the other, she smiles. Subtitle from 0:00: "כלים של קלינאית תקשורת חלק שש." Said (transcript): that line, then "קלינאיות בואו נהיה כנות".
q1_hook.why: A face, a voice, a product in hand and a headline from frame zero (H1, H4, S1, T3, H6). "Let's be honest, how hard is it to teach a resting posture? Very" at 0:02 names the viewer's pain (K6, H5). It calls out colleagues only, so a parent has no reason to stay.

beats.what: Mouthpiece and box held up; "כלים של קלינאית תקשורת חלק שש", "נהיה כנות", "מנח מנוחה תקין? מאוד."
beats.why: A series tag and a confession.

beats.what: Holds several mouthpieces; "איך מלמדים משהו אוטומטי"; "פה נכנסים הכלים הטיפוליים שלי"
beats.why: States the problem, then points to the tools.

beats.what: A box image appears top right; "ה-TLJ", "גם לעבודה אקטיבית וגם למנח סטטי"
beats.why: Names the tool and its two uses.

beats.what: "חמש עשרה סגירות", lip diagram 0:19, "הרמות לשון", tongue diagram 0:23; device in her mouth 0:27
beats.why: The routine in steps, with pictures.

beats.what: Two thumbs up; "מה אני הכי אוהבת", "הוא נותן קלט מאוד ברור"; she bends the device
beats.why: Her favourite feature, said with a smile.

beats.what: A nose diagram from 0:41; device in her mouth; "לסת לא שמוטה, שיניים כמעט סגורות"
Points down; "רוצות קישור ל-TLJ? כתבו \"אני\" בתגובות ואשלח לכן."; a wave and a smile

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: On screen at 0:54 and in the caption: comment "אני" to get the link to the device. A follow ask follows at 0:57 ("המשיכו לעקוב לטיפים נוספים"). Nothing asks to send it to a colleague.
q2_flow.why: A numbered routine of 15 and 15 with a diagram per step and a change of prop every 5 to 10 s keeps a 60 s single take moving (R3, K4), and the confession opens a gap the tool answers (H5). There is no visual cut for the colleagues' sake, and no principle on the list covers a professional audience.

q3_cta.what: On screen from 0:53 and said (transcript): "רוצות קישור ל-TLJ? כתבו \"אני\" בתגובות ואשלח לכן." At 0:57 "להתראות והמשיכו לעקוב לטיפים נוספים של קלינאית". Caption: the same keyword ask as the last line.
q3_cta.why: A comment word that delivers a real link (C3, R6), said and shown after the value (C6), the same ask in all three places (C1). But the keyword is a one-word generic "אני", a follow ask is stacked on it (C1), and the text sits in the bottom 35% (F2).

q4_shown.what: The mouthpiece in her hand from 0:00 and in her mouth at 0:27, 0:30 and 0:45 to 0:50; a white box at 0:01; inserted images: box art (0:13), a lip diagram (0:19), a tongue diagram (0:23), a nasal diagram (0:41). No patient, price or result.
q4_shown.why: The tool is handled from frame zero and used on camera, which is checkable (S1, F8). Its first-person use, "הכלים הטיפוליים שלי", is the only vouching (S6). The inserted diagrams are stock, in English and too small to read (F4). Showing it in her own mouth is not an option for a child's book (S5).

q5_edit.what: One continuous 60 s take, no cuts. Word-by-word subtitles change every 1 to 2 s in yellow, red or white. Four inserts appear at the top right (0:13, 0:19, 0:23, 0:41) and leave. Ends on a wave and a smile at 0:57 to 0:59.
q5_edit.why: With no cuts, the pace comes from her gestures, props and inserts (E2, R3). Colour-coded subtitles keep a muted viewer on track (E4, T1), though they are close to a full transcript (T2). It ends right after the sign-off (E8), but 60 s is long for one tool (R2).

q6_topic.what: A myofunctional therapy device that helps patients with a resting tongue posture, explained to other speech-language pathologists. Serves clinicians, not parents.
q6_topic.why: The routine and the nasal-obstruction benefit are practical, delivered with warmth and a joke (K4). A numbered routine is worth saving or sending to a colleague (R7, R5). No principle on the list covers a professional-to-professional topic, and the parent-concern and occasion principles do not apply.

q7_filmed.what: A handheld, very close low-angle selfie in a white room, the face filling the frame, the phone tilting as she gestures. She holds the device to the lens, puts it in her mouth, points down.
q7_filmed.why: Direct eye contact and a close phone make a very native creator look (F6, H8). Props held near the lens are large enough to read (F4). The low angle, the tilting camera and the face at the top edge are less flattering (F7, F2). Full 9:16 (F1, F3).

q8_text.on_screen: Bold word-by-word subtitles over the chest, about 80 to 87% down, 1 to 2 lines, yellow, red or white, with emoji (😖 near "מאוד", a lips emoji at 0:10): "כלים של קלינאית תקשורת חלק שש." (0:00), "איך מלמדים" (0:06), "חמש עשרה סגירות" (0:19), "מה אני הכי אוהבת" (0:31), "רוצות קישור ל-TLJ?" (0:53), "כתבו \"אני\" בתגובות" (0:55).
q8_text.caption: "כלים של קלינאיות תקשורת חלק 6 👄👅". About 140 words: a confession, the problem, the two-step routine with emoji bullets, what she likes, the main advantage, and "כתבו “אני” בתגובות ואשלח לכן 👇" last. No hashtags, no disclosure.
q8_text.why: The headline and colour-coded keywords work muted (T1, T3), but the lines sit in the bottom 35% (T4, F2), fade to faint at 0:39 (T5), and "TLJ" and "JAW EXERCISER)" put Latin letters mid-line or first (T6). The caption has a series hook, product words and no hashtags (T7), and no partnership word (T8).

weak_points: A clinical tool for colleagues, not parents; subtitles in the bottom band, some faded; stock diagrams too small and in English; a follow ask on top of the keyword; no hashtags; the partnership is not stated.
lumebook_takeaway: Hold the book to the lens and open it in one take, a numbered routine with one prop per step, and one comment word that delivers a free card.
not_verified: Whether the partnership was paid (a co-author is listed, no label, no word); the full device name on the second box ("myo" only); music (none evident); whether the link is delivered. Corrections to the first pass: the white box appears at 0:01, not in the first frame; there are four inserts (box art 0:13, lip diagram 0:19, tongue diagram 0:23, nasal diagram 0:41), not three.
